aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:872.title: Fall Intern, Premium Business – Crypto.com Arena
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:872.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Crypto.com Arena is where the world comes to play, perform, and come together. As one of the most iconic venues in sports and live entertainment, we host unforgettable moments, from championship games and global tours to once in a lifetime events that define the culture of Los Angeles. Owned and operated by AEG, our team brings live experiences to life with creativity, precision, and pride. Every role plays a part in creating nights fans remember, powered by people who care about the details and the impact of getting it right. If you want your work to show up in real moments, in a venue where history is made every night, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here. Job Summary: AEG Internship Program offers a real-world experience that allows college students to learn the business of sports and live entertainment. This is a great opportunity to work with an energetic team of professionals that focuses on premium sales, services, and operations at Crypto.com Arena. The intern will gain hands-on experience in premium sales and licensing, enhancing their skills in client-facing sales and building relationships. The intern will also gain insight into how premium seating products are marketed, sold, and serviced. Responsibilities: Conduct research on prospective clients, including corporate accounts, high-net-worth individuals, and industry specific targets Assist in identifying new business opportunities for premium seating products through market research and generating leads Compile research and insights to support premium sales strategies and outreach efforts Assist in scheduling and participating in client meetings (virtual and in-person) related to premium seating and licensing opportunities Join sales representatives on dark day arena tours and prospecting dinners to gain first-hand exposure to client presentations Provide support during select event days by assisting with client engagement initiatives and premium space activations Observe premium client service operations to understand the full lifecycle of premium seat licensing and retention Qualifications: Currently pursuing a degree in a relevant field Interest in sports and live entertainment Experience with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams, Forms) Strong written and verbal communication skills Detail-oriented Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, strong multi-tasker The AEG internship program requires a minimum commitment of 18 hours per week during the Fall Intern Perks: Outstanding opportunity to get an inside view across the entire AEG global portfolio: sports, entertainment districts, live music and events, arenas, clubs, and theaters. Resume review with AEG Talent Acquisition team Corporate networking Location: Los Angeles, California (On-site) Pay Scale: $19.00 - $21.00 Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current AEG bonus plan requirements. AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants,

ansatzcapital-ansatzcapital:lever:b2ebfe.title: Research Engineer
ansatzcapital-ansatzcapital:lever:b2ebfe.description: We are looking for a research engineer to research, test, and deploy new trading strategies, as well as to design and build research infrastructure to test trading ideas. Candidates focusing on strategy development should be strong quantitative problem solvers interested in identifying and monetizing statistical patterns in the financial markets and also adept at implementing their ideas in Python. We are looking for someone who is both intellectually curious and also self-sufficient to help maintain and develop various trading strategies. Candidates with software implementation skills and comfort in implementing both performant code and designing user-friendly tools will also be strongly considered. We are looking for someone who is effective at building usable software quickly and correctly to extend the scope of our quantitative research and coverage of our trading strategies. Compensation consists of base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and possible participation in longer-term incentive schemes.
responsibilities: Writing Python code to express statistical ideas and relationships between securities
Coming up with and iterating upon novel ideas and hypotheses about market participants and dynamics
Collaborating with teammates on new trading ideas
Extending existing research tools to support novel use cases and needs, as well as designing and implementing new tools to support research and trading needs
qualifications: Bachelor’s in computer science, mathematics, physics, or similar field, with strong familiarity with statistics and quantitative problem-solving
Self-sufficient ability to implement statistical ideas in code
Strong familiarity with Python and C++ (or equivalent) preferred
Interest in financial markets or learning more about financial markets
Previous experience in quantitative finance or trading is a plus, but is not required

bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:1a2f7b84-48cf-.title: Advertising Operations Specialist
bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:1a2f7b84-48cf-.description: At Bumble, we’re building the Love Company — a place where healthy, equitable relationships and friendships can start (and keep growing). The Growth Ads team helps bring that mission to more people by running high-quality, trustworthy advertising that respects our community and strengthens our brand. As our Advertising Operations Specialist, you’ll be the calm, detail-obsessed engine behind scalable ad delivery: championing clean setups, reliable measurement, and smooth cross-functional ways of working. You’ll do this while living our values; showing Respect in every partner interaction, and Excellence in how you raise the bar on quality, accuracy, and integrity. This role supports the delivery and performance of our advertising across platforms. Helping manage direct advertising campaigns on Bumble while overseeing programmatic monetization on Badoo to ensure inventory is efficiently utilized and optimized.
responsibilities: Own end-to-end ad operations across direct campaigns, ensuring accurate trafficking, implementation, QA, and on-time delivery with consistently strong execution.
Troubleshoot technical issues related to delivery, creative rendering, ad tags, measurement discrepancies, and platform integrations.
Partner closely with Growth, Sales/Partnerships, Marketing, Analytics, and Product to translate campaign goals into clean operational plans and take ownership from setup through reporting.
Run pacing, creative rotations, and flight management for direct campaigns; proactively spot issues and resolve them before they impact performance or partner trust.
Support and maintain programmatic partner relationships, helping troubleshoot delivery issues and ensure proper setup and performance.
Analyze programmatic performance and drive indirect demand optimizations to improve yield and inventory utilization.
Maintain and improve ad tech platform operations (e.g., ad server workflows, naming conventions, inventory/creative specs, troubleshooting, and documentation).
Support measurement and reporting: ensure tracking is correctly implemented, performance is clearly communicated, and insights are actioned in an agile way.
Help strengthen governance (brand safety, policy compliance, and operational controls) to protect the member experience and build long-term trust.
Use AI tools thoughtfully to streamline operational workflows (e.g., automated QA checks, anomaly detection, smarter reporting narratives), while keeping human judgment at the centre.
Continuously improve processes: identify friction, simplify handoffs, and build scalable playbooks so the Ads team can move faster without sacrificing quality.
Deliver clear, client-facing performance reports, translating campaign data into actionable insights for internal stakeholders and advertising partners.
Own end of campaign reporting, including delivery summaries, performance insights, KPI commentary, and recommendations for future activation.
qualifications: Deeply experienced with Google Ad Manager (GAM), managing day-to-day operations including campaign trafficking, line item setup, inventory management, QA, delivery troubleshooting, and maintaining scalable, well-structured ad server workflows.
Typically requires 4+ years of advertising operations experience; we may consider 3+ years for exceptional candidates with strong hands-on platform experience.
You’re comfortable analyzing programmatic performance and making optimization decisions to improve yield and delivery.
You’re fluent in performance measurement and reporting fundamentals; comfortable partnering with Analytics to define KPIs, validate tracking, and turn results into clear next steps.
You’ve worked with ad tech operations and platform workflows (ad server and/or programmatic tooling), and you’re energised by making systems cleaner and more scalable.
You collaborate with purpose: you communicate clearly across functions, set expectations early, and bring people along with empathy and Respect .
You take ownership and see things through from insight to impact, especially when details are messy and priorities shift.
You bring an agile mindset: you iterate fast, improve processes continuously, and stay calm under change.

You’re comfortable using AI in day-to-day work (e.g., drafting partner updates, accelerating QA/reconciliation checks, exploring anomalies, or improving documentation), and you’re thoughtful about data privacy and accuracy.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:e8c.title: Store Floor Lead (Sur La Table)
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:e8c.team: 102 - Hearst Tower - Sur La Table, 306 West 57th Street, New York, NY 10019
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:e8c.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Store Floor Lead at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the retail store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. In this leadership role, the StoreFloor Lead supports the General Manager (GM) or Store Manager (SM) in achieving sales and operational goals. As a key driver of in-store performance, Store Floor Lead serves as the Manager on Duty (MOD), ensuring smooth daily operations and always delivering a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development · Lead the sales floor and oversee daily store operations as Manager on Duty (MOD). · Provides in-the-moment coaching and feedback to elevate performance and team engagement. Communicate performance issues directly to the General Manager/Store Manager. · Support onboarding, training, and development of new associates. Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture. · Address customer concerns and resolve issues in a timely manner to maintain satisfaction and loyalty. Sales & Business Performance · Support the achievement of store sales goals through effective customer engagement and team motivation. · Maximize selling opportunities by identifying customer needs and offering relevant solutions. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Operations & Compliance · Direct employees to ensure appropriate merchandise stock levels and that the selling floor is adequately stocked and merchandised in accordance with visual standards. · Complete inventory transactions including, but not limited to, receiving, MOS (Mark Out of Stock), and RARs (Return Authorization Requests). · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers. · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time. · Ability to move about the store coaching and directing associates; selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel, and crouch to retrieve and replenish merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise. · Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work. · Workweeks are expected to be between 20 and 25 hours with the ability to have a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. · Regular and predictable attendance. Qualifications & Experience · Must be 21 years of age or older at the time of employment. · 1 year

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:627b1f81-.title: Senior Backend Engineer - MoneyLion
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:627b1f81-.description: About Gen: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. About the Role: MoneyLion is a leader in financial technology powering the next generation of personalized products and content. We pride ourselves on serving the many, not the few, providing confidence through guidance, choice, and personalization. We’re looking for a deeply experienced backend engineer who brings strong ownership, sound technical judgment, and a high bar for engineering quality. This role is about making smart architectural decisions, designing resilient services, and building the systems that power reliable customer and marketplace experiences. You will help shape and scale the backend capabilities behind MoneyLion’s product surfaces, working closely with product, analytics, and engineering teams to support partner integrations, experimentation, event quality, and core business workflows. Key Responsibilities: - Take Ownership: You'll help maintain a high bar for quality through design reviews, code reviews, testing, observability, and production readiness. - Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with product, analytics, and fellow engineers to shape solutions and deliver reliably. - Architect for change: Design and build backend systems that are scalable, modular, and resilient to evolving product and business needs. - Improve Performance & Quality: Strengthen reliability, maintainability, observability, and operational excellence across critical services and workflows. - Build clean data flows: Create dependable APIs, events, and service boundaries that support partner integrations, experimentation, analytics, and downstream systems. - Lead AI-assisted development: Use AI tools for prototyping, scaffolding, refactoring, and exploratory development, then validate the output with strong engineering judgment. - Raise quality through testing: Build and maintain automated test coverage across unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end layers. About You: - Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and modern backend architecture. - Comfortable designing and operating RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed systems in production. - Strong working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases. - Familiarity with asynchronous and event-driven systems such as Kafka, SQS, or similar technologies. - Comfortable working in modern development environments, including Git-based workflows, containerized services, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes). - Strong grasp of reliability, observability, maintainability, and performance. - Familiarity with testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and modern development workflows. - Skilled at partnering with Product, Analytics, and engineering teams

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:75470eee-.title: Senior Data Analyst
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:75470eee-.description: We are looking for a hands-on, results-oriented, and intellectually curious Senior Data Analyst to join our Product Analytics team. Our mission is to uncover actionable insights about our customers and use them to create data products, analytical solutions, and self-service capabilities that improve our products, customer experience, and business performance. In this role, you will contribute across the end-to-end data lifecycle, including data acquisition, processing, analysis, and delivery. You will work with data from tens of millions of users and billions of data points, helping advance our analytical capabilities through scalable solutions, predictive analytics, experimentation, and automation. Example initiatives include lifetime value (LTV) prediction, early-warning signals for product performance, advanced statistical analysis of A/B tests, and automated monitoring solutions. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Develop a deep understanding of our products, customers, and business context. - Own analytics delivery end to end: understand business needs, design appropriate analytical solutions, define requirements, and collaborate with engineering teams through implementation. - Provide insights that support strategic and operational decisions through ad hoc analysis, A/B test evaluation, business monitoring, trend prediction, user segmentation, and early-signal analysis. - Build scalable and automated solutions that shorten time to insight and enable stakeholders to work more independently. - Develop SQL-based ETL processes, Microsoft Excel analyses, and Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions. - Apply AI tools and agents effectively to improve analysis, automation, and productivity. - Partner closely with Business Intelligence, Engineering, Product Management, and other teams across the company. - Contribute to the development and implementation of the Product Analytics team’s data strategy. WHAT YOU’LL BRING - At least three years of professional experience in an analytics role. - Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. - Strategic thinking and a track record of building scalable analytics solutions that save time and accelerate time to insight. - Experience translating business and analytical requirements into technical specifications and driving their implementation with engineering teams. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data and analysis into clear, actionable insights for business stakeholders. - Working proficiency in SQL. - Experience providing analytics for software products in close collaboration with software developers. - The ability to understand and work with source code, preferably in languages such as Python or C++. - Experience with Power BI or Tableau, and the ability and willingness to learn new tools quickly. - Working knowledge of statistics and its application to business and product analysis. NICE TO HAVE - Experience building AI agents or using AI to generate insights and improve analytical workflows. - Experience with predictive analytics, experimentation frameworks, user segmentation, or early-signal detection. - Experience working with large-scale user and product datasets.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:8bdf557e-be8a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Test Engineer based in India. This is a senior QA opportunity focused on ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of applications in Agile and Scrum environments. You’ll take ownership of comprehensive testing activities, from test case creation and execution through defect management and validation. The role combines functional, integration, and regression testing with close collaboration across engineering and business teams. You’ll help translate functional and technical requirements into effective testing strategies and actionable quality standards. The position also offers the opportunity to improve testing processes and identify areas where automation can increase efficiency and coverage. You’ll work independently while contributing to multiple Scrum teams and supporting complex technology initiatives. This is a strong fit for a detail-oriented QA professional who enjoys solving problems and continuously improving software quality.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:91fc29ce-d0c0-.title: Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:91fc29ce-d0c0-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist based in Germany. This is a senior creative role focused on shaping intuitive, expressive, and highly engaging interfaces for mobile games enjoyed by players around the world. You will define the visual identity of the game UI while building scalable systems that keep experiences consistent across devices and screen sizes. The role combines visual design, UX thinking, prototyping, design systems, and close collaboration with game development teams. You will transform concepts into polished interfaces, seamlessly blending 2D UI with 3D game assets while maintaining strong hierarchy and visual impact. You will also contribute to modern AI-assisted workflows that accelerate ideation, exploration, and asset creation. Success requires both artistic excellence and a systems mindset, with a strong understanding of mobile gaming conventions and player behavior. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast-moving, remote-friendly environment where creativity, experimentation, and collaboration are highly valued. Define and own the visual direction, layout, interaction patterns, and overall artistic quality of mobile game interfaces. Create high-fidelity 2D UI assets, icons, screens, menus, and interactive elements that are colorful, polished, intuitive, and optimized for mobile devices. Integrate 2D UI layers with 3D game assets while maintaining visual hierarchy, depth, readability, and a cohesive aesthetic. Build, scale, and maintain a component-driven UI design system in Figma, including reusable components, variants, variables, auto-layout structures, and responsive behaviors. Design modular and reusable UI components that account for mobile platform constraints and different screen sizes and aspect ratios. Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and iconography that prioritize intuitive navigation, touch ergonomics, and engaging player interactions. Design interfaces for modern free-to-play meta systems, including progression tracks, Battle Passes, collection systems, rewards, and other engagement features. Collaborate closely with programmers, technical artists, producers, and other creative stakeholders to ensure designs are implemented accurately and retain their intended visual quality in-engine. Use generative AI and AI-assisted design tools to accelerate brainstorming, mood-board development, concept exploration, iteration, and asset generation. Maintain clear design documentation and communicate UI logic and design-system principles effectively to technical and creative teams. Contribute to UI animations, visual effects, and other implementation considerations where appropriate. Continuously refine the player experience by balancing visual excitement with clarity, usability, consistency, and performance. Requirements 10+ years of professional game-art experience, including at least 5 years specializing in UI/UX art. A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile game UI/UX work, including visual case studies or references from at least 2 shipped mobile titles. Excellent understanding of composition, color theory, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and stylized 2D game-art production. Deep knowledge of mobile game UI principles, including touch interfaces, gesture controls, ergonomics, and iOS/Android design considerations. Strong understanding of free-to-play game meta systems such as Battle Passes, progression tracks, collection systems, and reward loops. Expert-level proficiency with Figma, including auto-layout, nested components, variables, variants, design systems, and interactive prototyping. Strong proficiency with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for high-fidelity asset creation, iconography, vectors, textures, and visual treatments. Proven experience creating and managing comprehensive UI design systems and style

jobgether-jobgether:lever:deba70ce-4b1c-.title: Solutions Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:deba70ce-4b1c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Engineer based in Germany. As a Solutions Engineer, you will serve as a trusted technical and product advisor for enterprise partners across Turkey and the wider EMEA region. You will bridge customer needs with internal engineering, product, sales, compliance, and operations teams. The role combines technical consulting, API integration, solution design, pre-sales, and relationship management. You will guide customers from discovery and evaluation through implementation, onboarding, and long-term adoption. You will also help translate regional requirements into actionable product and engineering feedback. Fluency in Turkish and strong English communication will be essential in this highly international, customer-facing environment. Support enterprise customers: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer lifecycle, providing technical support, relationship management, and guidance on platform adoption. Lead solution engagements: Own technical engagements end-to-end, including discovery calls, solution validation, RFPs, security questionnaires, demonstrations, and technical consultations. Drive pre-sales activities: Partner with Sales and Solutions teams to design solutions, communicate technical use cases, support evaluations, and help prospective customers achieve successful technical outcomes. Guide implementations: Lead enterprise customers through API integration, implementation, onboarding, and ongoing platform adoption. Translate customer requirements: Represent the needs of Turkish-speaking customers internally, translating complex business and technical requirements into clear specifications for global Product and Engineering teams. Serve as a product expert: Develop a deep understanding of the platform and communicate its capabilities effectively to technical, business, and executive stakeholders. Coordinate regional requirements: Work with local compliance, operations teams, vendors, regulators, and partners to understand market-specific requirements and ensure they are communicated effectively to global teams. Develop technical resources: Create solution documentation, implementation guidance, product materials, and Turkish-language collateral where appropriate. Support product evolution: Stay informed about product development and collaborate with Product teams to test and roll out new features for enterprise partners. Represent the business externally: Participate in customer meetings and regional activities, with travel across Turkey and EMEA as required. Requirements: Enterprise technical experience: 3+ years of experience supporting B2B or enterprise customers in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, or a similar customer-facing technical role, ideally within API- or SaaS-focused businesses. API and integration expertise: Strong understanding of REST APIs, SDKs, software integration workflows, WebSockets, JSON, and tools such as Postman and Grafana. Language proficiency: Native or business-level Turkish with excellent customer communication skills and a strong understanding of Turkish business culture. English communication: Business-level English with the ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed, cross-functional teams. Technical communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible explanations for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ownership and execution: Self-motivated and comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, and driving complex assignments through to completion with strong attention to detail. Customer orientation: Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to balance technical problem-solving with commercial and customer objectives. Fintech knowledge: Experience in fintech, capital markets, brokerage, securities, or financial APIs

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ff7ee8ac-c197-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. This freelance opportunity is designed for an experienced Romanian voice professional interested in helping shape the next generation of AI-powered speech technology.
